title: Lapu-Lapu stuns Mandaue with winning triple in Governor’s Cup opener

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The opening games of the Governor’s Cup Under-18 Basketball Tournament 2026 lived up to their lofty billing, with the teams serving up tightly contested games on Sunday night, September 27, in the Mandaue City Sports and Cultural Complex. Lapu-Lapu City stole the spotlight after spoiling host Mandaue City’s opening game with a thrilling 70-69 victory, capped by Janos Bation’s buzzer-beating three-pointer from the top of the key.
